correction_summary: Phase 5.1 broad assertions claiming Section 122 penalty automatically flows from lack of Board resolution have been retracted and corrected. The absence of a Board resolution, legal supply authority, time of supply, and penalty provisions are distinct statutory questions requiring formal GST counsel review.

section_31.rule: Section 31(1) requires invoice at or before removal/delivery of goods. Delivered orders cannot be retroactively invoiced without qualified tax professional disclosure.

rule_46.rule: Rule 46(b) mandates consecutive serial numbers not exceeding 16 characters containing alphabets, numerals, and special characters (- and /).

section_122.correction: Section 122(1)(i) penalizes supply without invoice or false invoice; it does not criminalize internal corporate governance delays where no fraudulent invoice was issued.
